Three morning star is a 3-candle bullish trend reversal pattern. A morning star is a visual pattern made up of a tall black candlestick, a smaller black or white candlestick with a short body and long wicks, and a third tall white candlestick. The middle candle of the morning star captures a moment of indecision as where the bears begin to give way to bulls. The third candle confirms the reversal and can mark a new uptrend
